name: Qwen 3.5 122B
short: Alibaba's Feb 2026 open-weight MoE (125B total/10B active, Apache 2.0) for multimodal agents: GPQA 86.6%, SWE-bench Verified 72.0%, Terminal-Bench 2.0 49.4% at $0.26/$2.08 - not on Zen.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: The vision-language agent MoE: image-in reasoning plus tool use at a friendly active-parameter budget.
tradeoff: Apache weights mean self-hosting the full 122B stack — or trusting third-party hosts.
